params.name: microdeposit_guid
params.description: The unique identifier for the microdeposit. Defined by MX.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to verify the amounts deposited into the account during a microdeposit verification. The verification has not successfully completed until the `status` is `VERIFIED`. Poll the `/users/{user_guid}/micro_deposits/{micro_deposit_guid}` (read microdeposit) endpoint until you see this status or an error state.
